title: Weekly cyber recap: Drupal attacked within 24 hours, Mitel compromised before the patch, 15 KEV flaws in three days
content_md:
Weekly cyber recap: Drupal attacked within 24 hours, Mitel compromised before the patch, and 15 flaws added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog in three days, from November 22 through November 28.

Original article: https://lelabtechnique.fr/recap-cyber-de-la-semaine-drupal-attaque-en-24-h-mitel-pris-avant-le-patch-15-failles-au-kev-en-trois-jours-22-28-novembre/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social
exclude_reason: Generic weekly cyber recap that compresses several already-covered stories without new reporting.
